words.chinese: 出席人數眾多；參與人數龐大
words.example: The conference saw a large attendance, exceeding all expectations.

words.chinese: 安排會議，通常指協調時間、地點、議程等細節。
words.example: Could you arrange a conference call between our team and the overseas branch next week?

words.chinese: 參加會議；出席會議
words.example: All department heads are required to attend the annual management conference.

words.chinese: 出席；參加（會議、活動等）
words.example: All employees are required to attend the mandatory safety training session.

words.chinese: 參加者；出席者
words.example: All attendees are requested to register at the front desk before the workshop begins.

words.chinese: 與會者；參加者（通常指正式活動或會議的參與者）
words.example: The conference organizers expect over 500 attendees this year.

words.chinese: 注意；關注；在工作、會議或其他商務情境中對資訊、指示或細節的專注與留意。
words.example: Please give your full attention to the quarterly sales figures during the presentation.

words.chinese: 舉行；舉辦（活動、會議等）
words.example: The annual sales conference will be held in New York City next month.

words.chinese: 集思廣益；腦力激盪
words.example: Let's brainstorm some new marketing strategies to increase brand awareness.

words.chinese: 召開緊急會議
words.example: The CEO decided to call an urgent meeting to address the declining sales figures.

words.chinese: 董事會主席；主導會議的人
words.example: The chairman opened the meeting by thanking everyone for attending.

words.chinese: 會議主持人；主席
words.example: The chairperson will begin the meeting promptly at 9:00 AM.

words.chinese: 圖表；數據圖表（用於呈現數據和趨勢）
words.example: The presentation included several charts illustrating the company's sales performance over the past year.

words.chinese: 進行、執行（研究、調查、會議等）
words.example: The research team is conducting a survey to gather customer feedback.

words.chinese: 商議；討論（通常指正式的會議或討論）
words.example: The board of directors will confer on the proposed merger.

words.chinese: 評論；批評；評論文章
words.example: The director asked for a constructive critique of his new film.

words.chinese: 深思熟慮；仔細討論
words.example: The board of directors engaged in lengthy deliberations before making a final decision.

words.chinese: 促進者；引導者，協助會議或討論順利進行，引導參與者達成共識。
words.example: The meeting facilitator ensured everyone had a chance to share their ideas.

words.chinese: 主講者；重點演講者（通常指在活動或會議中被特別邀請或選定的演講者）
words.example: The conference will feature a renowned industry expert as the featured speaker.

words.chinese: 最終、終於；用於表示在經過一段時間或多項程序後的結論或結果
words.example: Finally, we will implement the new pricing strategy starting next quarter.

words.chinese: 示範；展示操作或功能
words.example: The sales representative will give a demonstration of the new software to potential clients.

words.chinese: 邀請來賓演講者；蒞臨演講的嘉賓
words.example: The conference organizers invited a renowned industry expert as a guest speaker.

words.chinese: 主旨演講；重點演講
words.example: The CEO will deliver the keynote speech at the annual conference.

words.chinese: 主旨演講；重點演講（通常在會議或活動中，由重要人物發表演講，闡述主題或觀點）
words.example: The CEO will deliver the keynote address at the annual conference.

words.chinese: 主題演講者；主要演講者，通常在會議或活動中負責發表重要演講。
words.example: The keynote speaker at the conference is a renowned expert in artificial intelligence.

words.chinese: 講台；演講台
words.example: The speaker placed his notes on the lectern before beginning his presentation.

words.chinese: 演講台；講台
words.example: The speaker placed his notes on the lectern before beginning his presentation.

words.chinese: 製作並發表簡報；向大眾展示資訊或觀點。
words.example: The marketing team needs to make a presentation on the new product launch to the investors.

words.chinese: 會議；會面
words.example: The project team will hold a meeting to discuss the revised timeline.

words.chinese: 會議時間；預定會議的時段
words.example: Please confirm the meeting time with all participants before sending out the calendar invite.

words.chinese: 會議；會談
words.example: The manager scheduled a series of meetings to discuss the new marketing strategy.

words.chinese: （通常指在會議或書面文件中）遇到；遭遇；碰到
words.example: The project team will meet with the stakeholders next week to discuss the progress.

words.chinese: 主持會議，引導會議進行，確保會議順利進行並控制討論方向。
words.example: The project manager will moderate the meeting to ensure all team members have a chance to speak.

words.chinese: 參與者；出席者（指參與活動、會議或研討會的人員）
words.example: The conference organizers expect over 200 participants from various industries.

words.chinese: （演講、簡報等）語氣、表達方式；（聲音）音高
words.example: The sales team needs to refine their pitch to better resonate with potential investors.

words.chinese: PowerPoint 是一種由 Microsoft 提供的簡報軟體，用於製作包含文字、圖片、影片等多媒體元素的演示文稿。
words.example: The marketing team is preparing a PowerPoint presentation to showcase the new product line.

words.chinese: 簡報；演示，通常指正式的演講或展示。
words.example: The marketing team is preparing compelling presentations for the upcoming sales conference.

words.chinese: 簡報者；主講人；主持人；頒獎人
words.example: The presenter introduced the new product features to a large audience.

words.chinese: 主持；主導（會議、儀式等）
words.example: The CEO will preside over the annual shareholders' meeting.

words.chinese: 私人的；僅限於特定人員或團體的，常用於指僅限於內部或機密的會議、資訊或空間。
words.example: The manager scheduled a private meeting with the client to discuss confidential terms.

words.chinese: 會議記錄、議事過程；正式的會議紀錄或程序。
words.example: The conference proceedings will be published online next week.

words.chinese: 投影機；放映機
words.example: Please set up the projector for the presentation.

words.chinese: 建議；提議；主張；（商業）提議，交易；（待解決的）問題
words.example: The board is currently reviewing a proposition to expand into new markets.

words.chinese: 提出（建議、計畫、觀點等）；延遲（時間、日期等）
words.example: The marketing team will put forward a new advertising campaign next week.

words.chinese: 達成共識；全體一致同意
words.example: After a lengthy discussion, the board members finally reached a unanimous agreement on the new marketing strategy.

words.chinese: 重新考慮，再三思量，重新審議，再研究
words.example: Please reconsider your decision before we finalize the project plan.

words.chinese: 再次召開（會議等）
words.example: The board of directors will reconvene next week to discuss the merger proposal.

words.chinese: 茶點、飲料及小食，通常在會議、活動或接待時提供。
words.example: The conference organizers provided complimentary refreshments for all attendees.

words.chinese: 排練; 預演; 彩排
words.example: The team conducted a full rehearsal of the presentation before the big meeting.

words.chinese: 排練；練習（演講、表演等）
words.example: The sales team will rehearse their presentations before the quarterly review.

words.chinese: 報告；正式的書面或口頭陳述，用於提供資訊、分析結果或建議
words.example: The sales manager will present the quarterly reports at the meeting tomorrow.

words.chinese: 召開會議；主持會議
words.example: The project manager will run a meeting to discuss the revised timeline.

words.chinese: 研討會；以專業主題為中心的短期講座或討論會，常用於企業內部培訓或行業交流。
words.example: The marketing department will host a series of seminars on digital advertising next month.

words.chinese: （會議、課程等的）階段、環節；（治療、諮詢等的）次數
words.example: The training program consists of three intensive sessions.

words.chinese: （投影片）簡報頁面；（滑動）滑動
words.example: Please review the slides before the presentation to ensure accuracy.

words.chinese: 學術研討會；學術會議（通常涉及專家學者，並有報告和討論）
words.example: The company's CEO will be presenting at the international symposium on sustainable business practices.

words.chinese: 視訊會議
words.example: Due to travel restrictions, we will hold a videoconference with our international partners.

words.chinese: 輔助視覺工具，指用於輔助演示或簡報的圖像、圖表、影片等。
words.example: The presenter used a variety of visual aids, such as charts and graphs, to illustrate the data.

words.chinese: 白板，通常用於會議、簡報或教學時書寫或繪製。
words.example: The presenter used a whiteboard to illustrate the project timeline.
